brief:
Over 11,200 people have gone missing in the Gaza Strip since the outbreak of war, the Ma'an news agency reported. The disappearances span the entire duration of the conflict, leaving families without information about the whereabouts or fates of their relatives.

The missing include civilians unaccounted for amid ongoing military operations and widespread destruction across the territory. Aid organizations and family networks have struggled to locate those who vanished, with many cases remaining unresolved as the conflict continues.
title: More than 11,000 people missing in Gaza since war began
